mainText: Good morning. Futures are higher this morning. The S and P 500 is up three tenths of a percent, the Nasdaq 100 is up eight tenths of a percent, and the Dow is flat. The 10 year Treasury yield is about 5.09 percent, little changed. Big movers: Nvidia is up 3.1 percent after an earnings beat and strong guidance. Nebius is up 5.6 percent. Take-Two is up 5.9 percent on the G T A 6 launch. Lowe's is down 4.3 percent after a margin cut. Applied Optoelectronics is down 10.7 percent on a 550 million dollar stock offering.
